verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm a Trello mobile app exists, with a mobile-specific camera text-scanning feature. A hands-on report says the iPhone app is 'very far from their web interface': reaching a checklist took 6-7 clicks, making it 'an order of magnitude less usable than their webapp.' Another early user noted there was no Android app. That evidence is old, and the vendor never explicitly claims desktop parity, so this is a thinly evidenced partial rather than a dispute. Missing for 10: documented feature parity between mobile and desktop, evidence of native apps across platforms (Android/iOS), and recent independent corroboration of mobile completeness.
